summary: Comprehensive Permissions + Accountability System audit completed. All 4 roles (Manager, Accountant, Cashier, Staff) tested for page visibility, action permissions, data scope enforcement, ownership rules, route protection, and UI elements. Backend: 21/21 tests passed. Frontend: 45/45 checks passed.

TestAuthAndPermissions.test_manager_login_and_permissions: PASS - Manager has all 21 permissions, data_scope=all
TestAuthAndPermissions.test_accountant_login_and_permissions: PASS - Accountant has 17 permissions, no view_users, no delete, data_scope=all
TestAuthAndPermissions.test_cashier_login_and_permissions: PASS - Cashier has 9 permissions, no expenses/users, data_scope=own
TestAuthAndPermissions.test_staff_login_and_permissions: PASS - Staff has 4 permissions, only dashboard+records+upload, data_scope=own

TestSalesPermissions.test_manager_soft_delete_sale: PASS - Manager soft-delete works (status=deleted, not in list)

TestDataScopeEnforcement.test_scope_enforcement_sales: PASS - Cashier sees only own sales, Manager sees all
TestDataScopeEnforcement.test_cashier_cannot_edit_others_sale: PASS - Cashier denied editing manager's sale (403/404)

TestCreatedByTracking.test_sale_has_created_by: PASS - created_by_user_id and created_by_name correctly set

manager_role.sidebar_visibility: PASS - Sees all nav items (dashboard, expenses, sales, vendors, items, reports, records, users)
manager_role.data_management_card: PASS - Sees Data Management card on Settings page
manager_role.reset_data_button: PASS - Sees Reset All Data button

accountant_role.sidebar_visibility: PASS - Sees expected items, does NOT see nav-users
accountant_role.data_management_card: PASS - Does NOT see Data Management card

cashier_role.sidebar_visibility: PASS - Sees dashboard, sales, records, vendors, items; does NOT see expenses, users, reports
cashier_role.data_management_card: PASS - Does NOT see Data Management card

staff_role.sidebar_visibility: PASS - Sees only dashboard, records; does NOT see sales, expenses, vendors, items, users, reports
staff_role.no_blank_screen: PASS - No blank screens after redirects
staff_role.data_management_card: PASS - Does NOT see Data Management card

created_by_display.sales_table_header: PASS - Sales table has 'Created By' column header
created_by_display.sales_table_avatar: PASS - Sales rows show avatar + name
created_by_display.expenses_table_header: PASS - Expenses table has 'Created By' column header
created_by_display.expenses_table_avatar: PASS - Expenses rows show avatar + name

features_verified: Manager (demo@test.com): All 8 page visibility permissions, all 13 action permissions, data_scope=all
Accountant (accountant@test.com): 7 visibility (no view_users), 10 actions (no delete), data_scope=all
Cashier (cashier@test.com): 5 visibility (no expenses/users/reports), 4 actions (no delete/expenses), data_scope=own
Data scope enforcement: Cashier sees ONLY own sales, Manager sees ALL sales
Ownership enforcement: Cashier cannot edit/delete other users' records (403)
Soft-delete: Manager delete sets status=deleted, record excluded from list queries
Route protection: Unauthorized page access redirects to first allowed page (not blank)
UI: Created By column with avatar+name in Sales and Expenses tables
UI: Data Management card visible ONLY for Manager role on Settings page
critical_code_review_comments: Backend permissions.py: Correctly implements ALL_VISIBILITY, ALL_ACTIONS, DEFAULT_DATA_SCOPE per role
Backend sales.py: apply_scope_filter() correctly filters by created_by_user_id for scope=own users
Backend sales.py: update_sale correctly checks _user_scope and denies editing others' records
Backend sales.py: delete_sale performs soft-delete (status=deleted) preserving audit trail
Frontend App.js: PermRoute correctly redirects to first allowed page via getFirstAllowedPath()
Frontend Layout.js: Sidebar correctly filters nav items by user.permissions[item.perm]
Frontend SettingsPage.js: Data Management card correctly wrapped in authUser?.role === 'manager'
seed_data_creation: Test sales created and cleaned up during scope enforcement tests
